notes.title: [0.21] Simulation
notes.content:
[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] The simulation has acquired all the basic parameters and now allows to create a fight of up to 100 units with selection of species.
[*] Water goes out at intervals.
[*] A couple of shallows increasing the land.
[*] Spawn points are spread throughout the map.
[*] Added ambient sound.
[/list]
[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Simulation: The new Thirst & Defend movement, in which animals endure those around them, until damage or the end of the water.
[*] Simulation: The species forgive the damage and hunt together until the water goes out.
[*] Simulation: Navigation accuracy and decision-making speed.
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Crocodile dry rate increased.
[*] ...
[/list]

notes.title: [0.2] Canyon
notes.content:
[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] The new map "Canyon" on the new level of the graphics, is very vertical and abounds with closed spaces. The winter map should be implemented later.
[*] One button battle with automatic definition of home region.
[*] The animals have acquired individual progress (survival time + damage). New skins will be added later.
[/list]
[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] The simulation has acquired Thirst & Hunt movement to replace Chaotic. Use Space and RMB for spectation by default.
[*] The user interface is simplified and centered, health and dry bars have appeared.
[*] The queue system on the servers allows to bring together all those waiting, at a higher cost of waiting.
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Chinese citizens get access to servers.
[*] ...
[/list]
